prompt:
One single moored wooden two-masted sailing ship for a top-down pixel-art JRPG harbour map, seen from the classic steep 3/4 top-down RPG angle, hull pointing to the right, sails furled on the yards, coiled ropes, crates on deck, a lantern on the stern (unlit). About 160 art pixels long (each art pixel about 6x6 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Background: fully transparent, no water, no shadow, no text.
revised_prompt: Generate one isolated game-ready sprite: a SINGLE moored wooden two-masted sailing ship, classic steep 3/4 top-down JRPG harbour-map perspective, long hull pointing RIGHT, complete vessel visible and centered. Sails tightly furled on the horizontal yards, coiled ropes and a few crates clearly visible on deck, small UNLIT lantern on stern. Ship roughly 160 logical art pixels in length; each logical art pixel must be a crisp uniform square across the ENTIRE sprite, about 6–8 output-image pixels wide. Premium modern hi-bit 2D JRPG pixel art with deliberately hand-placed pixel clusters of 3–10 art pixels, strong readable silhouette, no subpixel details. Flat hard-edged color areas with 4–6 shades per material: rich earthy worn timber and canvas; shadow colors saturated purplish/reddish, highlight colors warm yellow. Neutral soft even upper-left overcast-evening base colors ONLY: no cast shadows, no nighttime grading, no active light sources, no glow, no pools of lantern light, no vignette. Absolutely no antialiasing, blur, soft brushes, photography, texture noise or checkerboard dithering. Fully TRANSPARENT alpha background, NO water, NO ground, NO drop shadow, NO text, no other vessels or scenery.
